article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 14 Master Broadcasts Dated Across New National Guard Show, Behind the Scenes in Hollywood, Aunt Jemima, and Superstition
article-meta.kwd-group: New National Guard Show, Martin Block, Wendell Niles, Behind the Scenes in Hollywood, Frank McCormack, Sonja Henie, Aunt Jemima, Superstition, William Randolph Hearst, Chuck Mulkern, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 72 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 72 recovers and dates 14 historical broadcasts spanning late-1940s military variety shows, mid-40s Hollywood studio exposés, 1930s Southern vocal revues, psychological folklore dramas, Depression-era economic addresses, and Hawaiian acoustic sessions: 3 star-studded episodes of ***The New National Guard Show*** (1948, hosted by Martin Block and Wendell Niles featuring Kay Kyser), 3 studio insider profiles on ***Behind the Scenes in Hollywood*** (1945, narrated by Frank McCormack, covering Paul Lukas, Pat O'Brien, and Sonja Henie's ice-skating spectacles), 3 early-30s vocal broadcasts from ***Aunt Jemima*** (1931–1934), 3 episodes of the psychological folklore drama ***Superstition*** (1948), William Randolph Hearst's historic 1932 radio address ***How to Get Us Out of the Depression***, and Hawaiian guitar melodies from ***The Chuck Mulkern Program*** (1939).
